name: detector_benchmark_v1
purpose: Measure whether exact, perceptual, and motion-based duplicate detectors recognize same-trajectory rerenders under stress transformations while sparing independent and similarity-selected nearby events, at query-level false-removal rates calibrated on separate families.

transforms.texture: appearance plus a static random background texture
transforms.compression: appearance plus per-frame JPEG at quality 25
transforms.crop: appearance plus central 80% crop resized to 64x64
transforms.time_shift: appearance plus a 3-frame (0.12 s) temporal offset
transforms.distractor: appearance plus a third moving disk

detectors.silhouette: color-invariant 8x8 foreground occupancy per frame, negative RMS distance
detectors.centroid_motion: two-color foreground centroid tracks, negative RMS distance; extraction failure never matches
detectors.sscd_pooled: SSCD sscd_disc_mixup frame embeddings at 224 px, mean-pooled, cosine
detectors.sscd_aligned: SSCD frame embeddings, mean of time-aligned per-frame cosines
detectors.dinov2_pooled: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 CLS embeddings at 224 px, mean-pooled, cosine
detectors.dinov2_aligned: DINOv2 frame embeddings, mean of time-aligned per-frame cosines
detectors.raft_flow: torchvision RAFT-small flow between sampled frames at 128 px, 8x8 average-pooled field, cosine
detectors.oracle_state: negative RMS state distance using simulator provenance (reference only)

query_score: maximum similarity over the full training gallery
calibration_rule: one threshold per detector and operating point: the higher-method (1 - alpha) quantile of pooled calibration easy-negative query scores across all transforms; a query is removed when its score strictly exceeds the threshold
metrics: hard-negative (similarity-selected nearby) false removal per transform
AUROC positives vs easy negatives and vs hard negatives
top-1 source retrieval accuracy for removed positives
registered_expectations: Exact hashing has near-zero recall under every transform.
Learned perceptual descriptors degrade under texture and crop and treat similar-looking independent collisions as near matches.
Motion descriptors are robust to color changes but fail under mirroring, and the two-color centroid extractor fails under texture and distractors.
Similarity-selected nearby negatives produce higher false removal than unrestricted negatives for motion and state-based detectors.
claim_boundary: Synthetic 64x64 collisions. Pretrained perceptual models receive upsampled frames outside their training distribution. Results characterize detector behavior on lineage ground truth; they do not measure exposure effects.
